title: When no parts qualify, no totals row is shown
permissions_required: A role with the existing inventory-reports permission (Story 1 prerequisite).
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The filters can be set so that no part qualifies (for example, a part search matching nothing).
steps: 1. Apply a filter or search that leaves no qualifying part.
2. Look at the bottom of the data area.
expected: 1. The no-data message shows instead of rows and NO totals row is shown.
